service.name: The Minstrel's Ballad: Sphene's Burden
service.longDescription: The Minstrel’s Ballad retells Sphene’s sorrow as a hymn of steel. Clear the ballad on Extreme with our raiders — Wings of Eternity and Totems Eternal along the way.

rewards.title: Mount Drop (Not Guaranteed)
rewards.text: — Rare drop, can drop from this trial.

rewards.title: Trial Totems
rewards.text: Exchangeable for mounts, weapons and glamour.

rewards.title: Piloted or AFK Carry
rewards.text: Cleared by a veteran raider on your account, or alongside you in the party.

rewards.title: Achievement Unlocked
rewards.text: The Extreme trial achievement on completion.
